title: S. Elisabeth Lusitaniae: OCO 4 July vs proper_of_saints UNIVERSAL 5 July
prompt: OCO's TOC has 'Die 4: S. Elisabeth Lusitaniae' (p814) and its index uses day 4/7; proper_of_saints (UNIVERSAL) puts elizabeth-of-portugal on 5/7 (the US date — universally she is 4 July, moved in the US because of Independence Day). So 2 index rows ('0 saints on 4/7', pp1134/1139) have no slug. Fix the UNIVERSAL date to 4/7 (and keep 5/7 as a US-jurisdiction row), or map OCO 4/7 to the existing slug?

options.label: UNIVERSAL 4/7, US 5/7
options.detail: update proper_of_saints UNIVERSAL month/day; add a US row if the US calendar is modelled
